title: A Orchard for the Kitchen
author: Oscar Yarrow
blurb: Wren Vane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
